concept_name: Service delivery and provision of public goods
Financial sector regulatory and supervisory quality
rationale: Financial sector reg/supervisory quality: measurement-quality 0.75 - genuine construct gap. The only de-facto effectiveness signal (fatf_effectiveness) is a narrow AML/CFT slice; the rest (fatf_technical_compliance, brss) are de jure rules-on-paper. No broad prudential-supervisory-effectiveness measure exists for any country. Nudged not gutted (a real de-facto signal exists).
Trade governance: half relevance - trade openness is partly a policy STANCE, less central to the governance/accountability core of its category (locked 2026-07-21).
Environmental and climate governance: half relevance - a real but secondary dimension of the governance core for investor accountability (locked 2026-07-21).
